in_sanskrit.name: साकिन्दर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: साकिन्दर् (Sākindara) - साका (Sākā) + इन्द्र (Indra) - One who helps the Scythians (Sakas) or the God Indra

in_hindi.name: साकिन्दर
in_hindi.long_meaning: साकिन्दर (Sākindar) - सकाओं (Sakāōṃ) + मददारा (madadārā) - Helper of the Sakas

in_tamil.name: சகிந்தர
in_tamil.long_meaning: சகிந்தர் (Cakindar) - சகா (Cakā) + வழிக்குப்பவன் (vazhikkupavan) - Helper in the path of the Sakas

in_telugu.name: శకిన్దర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శకిన్దర్ (Śakindar) - శకాయుదేశ్ (Śakāyudēśa) + యదేశ్ (Yadēśa) - The God of the Sakas (Śakās)

in_marathi.name: Sakindar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sakindar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sakindar is a Hindu name that means 'God of prosperity'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of the words 'Sak' (god) and 'Indra' (king of gods, the god of wealth, and the god of thunder)
